item.description: Israel shows no sign of letting up its attacks on the devastated Palestinian territory, despite a 'ceasefire' in place.

item.title: Iran military warns US against Strait of Hormuz ‘interference’

item.title: Artist sews names of Gaza children killed by Israel into gown
item.description: Welsh artist Diana Williams stitched the names of 300 babies killed by Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza into a gown.
